title: Former Politico journalist asks Brent about Harrington's denial
summary: Brent Friedman tells of Former Politico journalist asks Brent about Harrington's denial, about November of last year to present at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman says that last November a journalist named Ben Schreckinger, who used to write for the news outlet Politico, asked him about a denial made by a man named John Harrington. Friedman tells it as part of a dispute over who knew what about UFOs, though the details of the denial are left vague.
